env XDG_DATA_HOME=$WORK/data

# 1. Empty state
exec gh-pt ls
stdout 'No applications are currently managed by gh-pt'

# 2. Add fake state
mkdir -p $WORK/data/gh-pt
cp state.json $WORK/data/gh-pt/state.json

# 3. List short format
exec gh-pt ls
stdout 'test/app'
stdout 'v1.0.0'
stdout '/usr/local/bin'

# 4. List long format
exec gh-pt ll
stdout 'test/app'
stdout 'binary/archive'
stdout 'v1.0.0'

# 5. List with filter
exec gh-pt ls test
stdout 'test/app'

# 6. List with non-matching filter
exec gh-pt ls notfound
! stdout 'test/app'

# 7. Explicit formats
exec gh-pt ll --format table
stdout '┌'
exec gh-pt ll -o list
! stdout '┌'
stdout 'test/app'
stdout 'Version'
stdout 'v1.0.0'

# 8. auto: wide terminal -> table, narrow terminal -> list
env COLUMNS=300
exec gh-pt ll
stdout '┌'
env COLUMNS=40
exec gh-pt ll
! stdout '┌'
stdout 'test/app'

# 9. Invalid format is rejected
! exec gh-pt ll --format bogus
stderr 'format'

# 10. tui without a terminal falls back instead of hanging
env COLUMNS=300
exec gh-pt ll --format tui
stdout 'test/app'

-- state.json --
{
  "version": 2,
  "apps": {
    "test/app": {
      "repository": "test/app",
      "version": "v1.0.0",
      "target_path": "/usr/local/bin",
      "global": false,
      "disabled": false
    }
  }
}
